name: Fully Automated
description:
About This Game

KEY FEATURES

  • Kill or Demoralize enemies

  • Morality system

  • 100 + power ups and 15+ combat archetypes 

  • Survive waves after waves of enemies

  • Dynamic boss encounters

PROTECT THE INNOCENTS

Defend the Communa, a pacifist utopia, from the greed of the Corporation! Use the power of cyborg martial arts to destroy or demoralize your enemies!  Will you break their bones, or break their spirit? 

TO KILL OR NOT TO KILL

Kill them or scare you opponents away, the choice is yours!  But it will have consequences for you and the ones you protect! 

UNLEASH YOUR POWER

Discover powerful microchips to unlock new techniques! Become an irresistible force or an immovable object!

EPIC BATTLES

Face down monstrous constructs, ancient war machines, and relentless enforcers in cinematic boss battles that test your resolve and reflexes.

TOUGH DECISIONS

Will you transform your community in a safe heaven, or an iron fortress? Will you show mercy? Or crush your foes? Will you achieve victory at all costs, or risk it all for peace? The world will react to your playstyle and decisions!
short_desc: Fully Automated is a fast paced action roguelite. Destroy or demoralize your foes, and shape the future of your world ! Face relentless waves of enemies and choose from a variety of upgrades and traits to create the perfect style. Will you be a force for peace or a demon of war?
